bagPolicy.summary: Nonclear bags must be no larger than 4.5 × 6.5 inches; clear bags must not exceed 12 × 6 × 12 inches. Ask the complex in advance for a medically necessary exception.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking is included for most ticketed events; when excluded, parking costs $10 per vehicle. Lots normally open two hours before the event.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concessions sell food and drinks. Outside food and drinks, including bottled water, are prohibited unless needed for medical or infant dietary purposes.
allowed: Medically necessary or infant dietary food

accessibility.summary: Wheelchair seating is available in Bojangles sections 106, 108, 110, 121 and 123; an accessible-seat buyer can purchase up to three companion seats.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call is at the box office by the Bojangles entrance; hours are Wednesday and Friday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and from two hours before showtime on event days.
